name: Fat
overview: The Bible portrays fat as a symbol of abundance and blessing, as seen in Genesis where eating the 'fat of the land' signifies enjoying its best provisions. Fat was also set apart as sacred, belonging to the Lord and offered in sacrifices, with priests commanded to burn specific fats on the altar to consecrate offerings. Additionally, certain fats were forbidden as food, emphasizing holiness and separation in worship practices. Figuratively, fat can represent prosperity and richness, reflecting God's provision and favor.
